READ-ONLY SUCCESSOR AUDIT — ADVISORY HOLD, not a formal reviewer verdict. I inspected exact successor 3c3b617ab0b218749de69a695d0d45f13ec4431e against both blocked 067e35b523355886b5d38f5b205311f70227885f and base e1422d1332d67dc7f5b8ce0a7ff93bd68295e776. The three reported defects are materially repaired: the production RepetitionRule.Ignore arm now supplies RepetitionPolicy attribution; PlacementProducerSuite courts the throwing path and the zero-exclusion opposite; admitted inner attribution slack is absorbed while 4x tolerance is refused; distinct membership thresholds compare and render distinctly. git diff --check is clean. I did not run an sbt gate because the chief has the exclusive exact-main court running and collab owns formal review.

NEW BOUNDARY DEFECT: Resolution.scala:43 exposes BelowMembership(threshold: Double) directly. PlacementResolution.of lines 163-170 validates the attribution MASS values but never validates the threshold embedded in an ExclusionCause key. Therefore valid-looking PlacementResolution values can record BelowMembership(Double.NaN), positive/negative infinity, negative thresholds, or thresholds above 1, despite the stated purpose being to preserve which real membership threshold failed. This is a public invalid-state constructor and makes the repair itself able to publish nonsense evidence. Please either carry an already validated [0,1] type such as Probability (with explicit safe construction at real boundaries), or explicitly reject every non-finite/out-of-range BelowMembership threshold in PlacementResolution.of and add NaN/infinity/below-zero/above-one courts.

ADJACENT DETERMINISM: render sorts causes only by enum ordinal (lines 92-94). Multiple BelowMembership keys share the same ordinal, so their order remains Map-iteration-defined. If render can enter receipts, errors, or golden output, sort by a total semantic key including threshold after validation. I treat the invalid threshold as acceptance-bearing; the ordering issue is at least a required disposition. WHAT I DID NOT DO: no edit, claim, phase transition, candidate verdict, or gate. Formal disposition remains collab.
